item_1_esso.closure: energy_storage_cohort_soc_final: e[c,y,d,T] == 0.5 * E_av[c,y], exact, with or without params.slacks (D2). The 8c9fd6ec closure-slack Vars slack_es_soc_final_per_unit_up/_down and their objective term are UNWIRED (not constructed); the hasattr-guarded configure branch is retained for models built before
item_1_esso.complementarity_row: energy_storage_cohort_complementarity: (pch_c / S_c) * (pdch_c / S_c) <= ESS_COMPLEMENTARITY_TOLERANCE (1e-4), S_c = es_s_investment_fixed[c] (the cohort's rated power, a Param). The network sess_comp BILINEAR_RELAXATION form (the production network setting) on the cohort's dimensionless powers; equivalently pch_c * pdch_c <= 1e-4 * S_c^2 MW^2. INTERPRETATION: the task text writes 'p^ch_c * p^dch_c <= ESS_COMPLEMENTARITY_TOLERANCE' and 'of the sess_comp form'; the sess_comp form normalizes by S (P5.4-H1), so the row is built normalized. At S_c = 0.25 MW it caps min(pch, pdch) at sqrt(1e-4) * 0.25 = 0.0025 MW, i.e. at most 0.06 MWh per cohort per representative day if it binds in every period (the unnormalized reading would cap at 0.01 MW, 0.24 MWh/day)

t_iii.profile_rule: swing = (0.5-0.1) * f * sum_c E_cal(c) with E_cal = E_rated * phi^(n*k) (calendar-only end-of-block, an upper bound on E_av); phases at rate_mw from period 0, each on a new period, last partial: discharge swing*eta_dch, charge 2*swing/eta_ch, discharge swing*eta_dch; every other period 0; all periods fixed

t_iv.control: every period of the day fixed 0 (no peak)
t_iv.peak_rule: peak = midpoint of no_transfer_max = sum_c min(s_c, 0.4*E_cal_c*eta_dch) and with_transfer_max = min(s_A, 0.4*E_A*eta_dch) + min(s_B, (0.4*E_B + gain)*eta_dch), gain = max(0, 0.4*E_A - s_A/eta_dch)*eta_dch*eta_ch (A = 2025 cohort, B = 2030 cohort, calendar-only E); periods before the peak fixed 0, after the peak free (recharge to the closure)
